name: Capsule
avoid_for: Contexts that require traditional institutional weight — the capsule shapes and pastel pops actively soften authority
weak_cases: Floating pill decoration crowds dense data; many linked nodes overload the rounded shape vocabulary.
visual_signature: Bodoni display, outlined pills, warm/cool candy surfaces and hard-shadow lift.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: High-contrast serif display and compact pills need re-fit for other scripts and longer translations.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
